messages:
alex: Heads-up — after the int8 calibration swap for model redwood-small-v2 at ~08:14 UTC we're seeing p95 ~420ms (expected) but p99 jumped to ~1.1s across a subset of pods. Status codes 200, no obvious errors, request_id=abc123def. Anyone seen this after recent calib rollout?

ria: saw a couple of alerts. Are these requests hitting dedicated or hosted? any tenant isolation? :thinking:

alex: Hosted, multi-tenant lane. Affected pods are all in us-west-2. Can repro on a few sample reqs. No traffic spike.

michael: can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and a snippet of runtime logs? Also check whether fallback-to-fp16 flag is enabled — if fallback is disabled int8 latency could hit tail when KV-cache patterns diverge.

alex: repro curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-v2","input":"Summarize this...","quant_profile":"int8_calibrated","max_tokens":256}'
```
logs (excerpt): ```
2026-03-15T08:14:56.123Z request_id=abc123def pod=serving-23 recv=0.002s queue=0.01s exec=0.85s send=0.002s kv_cache_miss=1 quant_mode=int8
2026-03-15T08:14:57.456Z request_id=abc123def pod=serving-24 recv=0.002s queue=0.02s exec=0.90s send=0.003s kv_cache_hit=0 quant_mode=int8
```

tanya: interesting — exec near 0.9s is the culprit. Are we seeing GPU-bound stalls or CPU-side postprocessing? ops-qa, can you check kernel selection telemetry for those pods?

ops-qa: checking. kernel telemetry shows a fallback path kicking in intermittently: some layers running in slower emulation path due to quantized op mismatch for sequence lengths >128. This aligns with the requests. Also noticed a spike in auth token refresh failures around 08:12 which caused a brief surge of retries from clients (not visible in ingress QPS).

michael: that auth retry pattern could change request patterns and warm cache behavior — worth correlating. Also, billing reported a small uptick in billed tokens for that tenant during the window (billing id bill-992). Billing may have overcounted because of repeated retries.

ria: immediate mitigation options: 1) toggle the quant_profile back to fp16 for the tenant (fastest), 2) enable int8 fallback-to-fp16 for problematic pods, 3) pin model variant to quant_safe profile while we investigate. Which do we want as canary rollback?

alex: prefer option 2 first (soft fallback) so most users keep int8 benefits. How do we enable it via API?

michael: ops command (internal): ```json
POST /internal/ops/serving/config 
{ "pod_selector": "serving-23,serving-24", "quant_int8_fallback": true }
```
or user-facing: set header X-Quant-Fallback: fp16 on request to force fallback for the call.

tanya: i've kicked a config change to enable int8_fallback on the two pods. Monitoring now. Also opened INC-2026-88 (internal) to track repro, kernel mismatch layers, and auth retry correlation.

ops-qa: after enabling fallback p99 dropped to ~360ms within 2 minutes on those pods. No functional regressions observed in sampling of generation outputs. :thumbsup:

alex: can confirm — p99 back to baseline for sampled tenant. Logging shows quant_mode now fp16 for fallback calls. We'll keep this as our near-term mitigation and roll a safer recalibration.

michael: next steps: 1) deep dive kernel trace for layer mismatch (assign to eng-runtime), 2) audit calibration dataset used (eng-ml), 3) add auth-retry guard to avoid inducing cold-KV patterns (eng-infra). Set target: full fix and safe recalibration by EOD + canary day of 03/17.

ria: i'll notify the customer that we've mitigated and are investigating root cause. Noting billing team to reconcile bill-992 for potential duplicate token charges.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-88 created (priority: high). Slack thread linked.

alex: thanks all. i'll add a short repro script + list of request_ids to the ticket.

ops-qa: adding note — when we do the recalibration, run it in small sequence-length buckets and validate kernel selection traces to avoid hitting the slow emulation path.

michael: agreed. Also add an automated canary that measures p99 delta before promoting quant_profile to all pods.

ria: marking as monitoring. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
